topic: Negotiating a hospital bill down vs paying it (Rhett vs Sloane)

scenes.narration: One call cut a four thousand bill to nine hundred. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding up a phone and a hospital bill stamped FOUR THOUSAND, comic burst banner reads CUT TO NINE HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhett and Sloane both get four thousand dollar ER bills.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man rhett and woman sloane at kitchen tables each opening identical ER bills stamped FOUR THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both had a mild appendicitis scare two weeks earlier.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a calendar showing TWO WEEKS AGO with a small hospital icon, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhett puts the bill on a credit card to avoid collections.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rhett at a kitchen table swiping a credit card on a phone, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays twenty three percent interest and never asks for help.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit card statement with a giant red label reading TWENTY THREE PERCENT APR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sloane calls the billing office and requests an itemized bill.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sloane on a phone at a kitchen table with a notepad reading ITEMIZED BILL REQUEST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She asks for financial assistance and the cash pay discount.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sloane's notepad now also reading FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE and CASH PAY DISCOUNT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Three weeks later Rhett's bill ballooned to four thousand four hundred.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked rhett at a kitchen table looking at a credit card statement, comic banner reads FOUR THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He will pay nearly five thousand by the time it is gone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a long stretching calendar of payments and a red total reading FIVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sloane's itemized bill removed two duplicate charges immediately.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sloane circling two duplicate line items on an itemized bill, both stamped REMOVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Discounts dropped her total to just nine hundred dollars paid.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sloane smiling at a paid receipt stamped NINE HUNDRED PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Itemize, ask financial assistance, request cash pay discount. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading ITEMIZE THEN ASK, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
